description: Find leads for a search query in a location. Full pipeline: Google Maps → website crawl → email verification → VayaPin profile. Returns job_id to poll for results via get_job_results.

location.description: Location to search in (e.g. "Berlin", "Boston, MA"). If omitted, include location in search_query.

workflow.description: Pipeline config: { spidersite: { enabled, mode }, spiderverify: { enabled }, vayapin: { enabled } }. Defaults to full pipeline.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: lead_search
